completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. These Rules may be cited as the Feeding Stuffs (Composition of Offences) Rules.

2.—(1) The following offences may be compounded by the Director-General, or any officer authorised by him, in accordance with section 199A of the Criminal Procedure Code:
(a)an offence under section 4(5) or 10 of the Act; and
(b)any offence under the Feeding Stuffs (Licensing, Analysis and Fees) Rules (R 1).
(2) The Director-General, or any officer authorised by him, may compound any of the offences specified in paragraph (1) by collecting from the person reasonably suspected of having committed the offence a sum of money not exceeding one half of the maximum fine prescribed for the offence.
